rationale: Selected eight founder-accessible version-1 candidates with distinct commercial archetypes, control points, and critical dependencies: a Polish invoice-payment trust gate, consented gambling-safety cooperative, genomic recontact registry, renewable-equipment first-refusal network, installer tender authority, EV-roaming proof-clearing network, deposit-return reconciliation ledger, and battery-health transaction warranty. The set favors data, automation, Polish/EU context, renewable-family access, part-time validation, and partner-funded or asset-light starts while retaining two bounded physical-network experiments. Direct historical repeats and same-cohort structural near-duplicates were excluded; no absent archetype was identified by the cohort semantic audit.
